viewing_check: Look for the printed tissue/text, publisher imprint or Beldam text sheet, and whether the print is on plate-marked paper with fine stipple (original chromolithograph) versus a dot-screen halftone under a loupe (reproduction). Check whether prints are the 25x38cm size. Check the Bradman signature is printed. Check frame backs for old labels.
